code:
SELECT TOP 20
  qs.query_hash,
  SUM(qs.total_worker_time)
    AS total_worker_time,
  SUM(qs.execution_count)
    AS total_executions,
  SUM(qs.total_worker_time) /
    SUM(qs.execution_count) AS avg_worker
FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats qs
GROUP BY qs.query_hash
ORDER BY total_worker_time DESC;
caption: High worker time with no duration payoff = overhead, not benefit.
